slices.title: Roles persistence core and the rank uniqueness delta
slices.intent: the schema delta that drops the rank uniqueness constraint, and the app-owned admin-roles persistence module with defaults-and-overrides introspection, custom role create, update, reset, and guarded delete

symbols.name: ensureAuthSchema
symbols.expectation: modified: drops the `roles_rank_key` uniqueness constraint through the lazy ALTER pattern, so custom roles may share a seeded rank

symbols.name: listRolesWithPermissions
symbols.expectation: new: lists every role with rank, system flag, the rank-derived default set, and the `role_permissions` override map per role

symbols.name: createRole
symbols.expectation: new: inserts a custom role and its initial overrides, refuses system-reserved names

postcondition.signature: (queryable: Queryable, input: { name: string; rank: number; permissions: PermissionGrant[] }): Promise<Role>

symbols.name: updateRole
symbols.expectation: new: renames through `role_permissions.role_name` in one transaction, changes rank, replaces the override set

postcondition.signature: (queryable: Queryable, roleId: string, input: { name?: string; rank?: number; permissions?: PermissionGrant[] }): Promise<void>

symbols.name: resetRoleOverrides
symbols.expectation: new: deletes every `role_permissions` row for the role name

symbols.name: deleteRole
symbols.expectation: new: deletes only non-system roles with no `user_roles` row referencing them and no unrevoked, unexpired, unused invite naming them (`invites.role_name` with `used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now()`), then removes their override rows

symbols.name: listPendingInvites
symbols.expectation: reference: the existing pending-invites lookup (unused, unrevoked, unexpired predicate) that the deleteRole guard reads; unchanged by this batch

slices.title: Roles API routes and the self-lockout guard
slices.intent: the `roles.manage`-gated role routes, the self-mutation lockout guard on both the role routes and the user role assigner, and the route error copy

symbols.name: GET
symbols.expectation: new: gated `roles.manage`, returns the role list with defaults and overrides, guard wrapped in the nested Response-rethrow catch so the typed 403 survives both outer catch layers

symbols.name: POST
symbols.expectation: new: gated `roles.manage`, creates a custom role with initial permissions, guard wrapped in the nested Response-rethrow catch so the typed 403 survives both outer catch layers

symbols.name: PATCH
symbols.expectation: new: gated `roles.manage`, applies rename, rank change, permission overrides, or override reset, refuses mutation of the acting session's own role, guard wrapped in the nested Response-rethrow catch so the typed 403 survives both outer catch layers

symbols.name: DELETE
symbols.expectation: new: gated `roles.manage`, deletes a custom role with no attached users, refuses the acting session's own role, guard wrapped in the nested Response-rethrow catch so the typed 403 survives both outer catch layers

symbols.name: setUserRole
symbols.expectation: modified: refuses when `grantedBy === userId`, mirroring the self-ban refusal at `lib/persistence/admin-users.ts:125-127`, so an administrator cannot change their own assignment
